description: Engine setup of map2_s01 (Church), a map made only of data and Lua: "map_type" is the map type ER, the entry of gamedata/config/map_info.json that gives its zones, scenery file and environment. "characters" lists the character types this map runs, each by its gamedata/chara/<Name>/behavior.lua; a character type that is not listed cannot act here (this map: Dahlia and EndingDahlia). A mod changes it with its own maps/map2_s01/overlay.json.
